description: Integers from min to max inclusive, 1 to 1000 of them, with or without repeats. The range may hold at most 2^32 values. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

seed.description: Optional. 64 hex characters. Give the seed shown on an earlier result page to get the same result again (that is how a draw is checked). Leave it out for a fresh draw.

name: random_integer
title: Random integers
